text:
Rae (Product): quick follow-up from today's all-hands on pricing/quotas. Capturing a few concrete questions and action items.

Ivy (Finance): short summary: tokens are billed as normal. We enforce per-route and per-org windows. Paid tiers get a short grace-burst (standard: 15s, enterprise: 30s). After that, excess hits 429 or soft-throttle depending on policy.

Samir (Billing): credits expire 12 months for promos, 90 days for trials; enterprise contracts can override. We support optional auto-topup (off by default).

Tess (Support): when clients hit limits we return headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-Quota-Window, Retry-After. Body includes {"error":"rate_limited","retry_after_seconds":60}. We're piloting X-Credit-Balance for opt-ins.

leo_g (eng): ops detail: before a hard 429 we try smoothing, model-variant fallback (quantized), and routing to slower pools if customer policy allows. Fallbacks configurable per-org via routing policy.

Rae (Product): demo/launch capacity flow?

Ivy (Finance): demo passes: standard paid plans get 48-hour auto-approve up to 2x baseline; partners get 72-hour up to 3x. Above that needs Sales. Request via Support with expected TPS and peak tokens/sec.

Samir (Billing): APIs: GET /v1/account/credits (lightly rate-limited), GET /v1/usage/summary for per-route breakdown. Example string body: "balance: 12000, expires_at: 2027-09-01T00:00:00Z".

Tess (Support): refunds/adjustments: we audit and can issue credit adjustments case-by-case (platform bug or documented misconfig); typical turnaround 3-7 business days. Include request ids + timestamps.

Ava (CEO): no planned pricing changes next quarter. We'll publish clearer guidance on model-family pricing and quantization discounts in next product update.

Rae (Product): action items: I'll draft a short playbook with header examples, sample client backoff (respect Retry-After + jitter), and the demo-pass request template. Will post by EOD and link here.

NotifierBot: Slides + transcript uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s/all-hands/2026-06-pricing
